mapper.select: SELECT quantity FROM stock_reservations WHERE reservation_id=#{reservationId} AND product_id=#{productId} AND sku_id=#{skuId} AND status='RESERVED'
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_reservations SET status='RELEASED', released_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE reservation_id=#{reservationId} AND product_id=#{productId} AND sku_id=#{skuId} AND status IN ('RESERVED','COMMITTED')

UPDATE stock_reservations SET status='RELEASED', released_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE reservation_id=#{reservationId} AND product_id=#{productId} AND sku_id=#{skuId} AND status='RESERVED' AND expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
UPDATE stock_reservations SET status='COMMITTED' WHERE reservation_id=#{reservationId} AND status='RESERVED'

UPDATE stock_reservations SET reaper_claimed_by=#{worker}, reaper_claim_until=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL 60 SECOND) WHERE status='RESERVED' AND created_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) - INTERVAL 10 SECOND AND (reaper_claim_until IS NULL OR reaper_claim_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.select: SELECT reservation_id,product_id,sku_id,quantity FROM stock_reservations WHERE status='RESERVED' AND reaper_claimed_by=#{worker} AND reaper_claim_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY created_at
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_reservations SET reaper_claimed_by=NULL,reaper_claim_until=NULL WHERE reservation_id=#{reservationId} AND reaper_claimed_by=#{worker}
